title: Swarm of Swarms: Evolutionary Functional & 2D/3D Spatial Causal Simulation for Embodied AI
description: Mathematical specification, AI Safety alignment framework, and unified zero-leakage, noise-gated 2D/3D Active Inference & variational policy benchmarks (swarm_v7_1_core.py) for Embodied AI under non-stationary resource depletion, static correlated decoys, finite-speed causal delays, and energy winter regimes.
notes: Developed and independently verified via a triadic Human-AI methodology with ground-truth shuffling injection tests and noise-floor gating (APPROVED verdict on v7.1.0 across 400 zero-leakage 2D/3D benchmark runs).
